If an Alive check response is received on a socket connection which is in any ISO 13400 connection state "Registered" and the field "SourceAddress" matches the registered Source Address of this socket connection, then the DoIP mod- ule shall reset the general inactivity timer. Note: The alive check response can always be sent (not only after an according re- quest): With this method the test equipment can reset the inactivity time.
